# Assessment Templates

This directory contains templates for conducting various types of assessments within the enterprise architecture practice.
page_texts.2:
[resources/work-templates/assets/assessments/README.md#available-templates]

## Available Templates

- [Application Modernization Assessment](app-modernization.md) - Template for evaluating application modernization opportunities
- [EA Practice Maturity Assessment](eap-maturity.md) - Template for assessing the maturity of the EA practice
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/assessments/README.md#usage]

## Usage

Assessment templates help ensure:

- Consistent evaluation criteria
- Comprehensive coverage of key areas
- Standardized reporting formats
- Actionable recommendations
- Measurable outcomes

Each template includes:

- Assessment objectives and scope
- Evaluation criteria and scoring
- Data collection methods
- Analysis frameworks
- Reporting structure
- Follow-up recommendations
